questions.q: Why is a separate purchase order approval not redundant with the earlier requisition approval?
options: The requisition approval confirms the department should spend the money; the PO approval confirms the specific supplier, price, and terms are acceptable
It is redundant, and most companies skip one of the two
Purchase order approval only applies to international suppliers
Requisition approval and PO approval are performed by the exact same rule every time
questions.explain: Each approval answers a different question - whether to spend money at all, versus whether these specific negotiated terms are acceptable.

questions.q: Which of these is a valid method Oracle Fusion supports for communicating an approved purchase order to a supplier?
options: Only postal mail
Email, fax, Supplier Portal, or electronic document exchange such as cXML
Only a phone call from the buyer
Purchase orders cannot be communicated to suppliers electronically
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion supports several supplier communication methods including email, fax, the Supplier Portal, and electronic formats like cXML.

questions.q: How does Meridian Bearing Supply Co. receive this purchase order in this course's transaction?
options: By fax only
By a phone call from Marcus
Through the Supplier Portal, where their staff can view it directly online
Meridian never receives the purchase order at all
questions.explain: Meridian is set up to receive purchase orders through the Supplier Portal in this course's scenario.

questions.q: Is supplier acknowledgement required for a purchase order to be valid?
options: Yes, no purchase order is valid without it
Acknowledgement is only used for blanket purchase agreements, never standard purchase orders
Yes, but only for purchase orders over a certain dollar amount
No, it is optional, but it provides documented confirmation that the supplier received and accepted the order's terms
questions.explain: Acknowledgement is not required for validity, but it gives documented proof the supplier agreed to the quantity, price, and dates - useful if a dispute arises.

questions.q: What is the first point in this transaction where something outside LTV Manufacturing's own Oracle Fusion instance is affected?
options: When Dana submits her requisition
When Marcus's supervisor approves the requisition
When the approved purchase order is communicated to Meridian Bearing Supply Co.
When the distribution account is determined
questions.explain: Everything before communication to the supplier stays internal to LTV; the supplier only becomes involved once the approved PO is actually transmitted.
